info.title: DriveHire & CarPooling Platform
info.description: Approved lean scope: driver hiring and instant-join carpools. Driver hiring is implemented through Phase05; carpool delivery remains Phase06. Delivery evidence and limitations are recorded in docs/quality/phase-handoffs. No rentals, combined bookings, reviews, product notifications, payments, maps or GPS.
